title: Boebert asks about hybrid program at hearing

tellings.quote: >> She asked about hybrids and then [laughter] it was just a really weird moment in the congressional testimony.

plain: At a hearing in Congress on UFOs in the 2020s, Representative Lauren Boebert asked a witness about hybrids, meaning supposed mixes of human and alien. Michels recalls it himself, laughing, as a really weird moment in the testimony, since it hinted that such a program might be on the table.
